title: BENCHMARKING ETHICAL AND SAFETY RISKS OF HEALTHCARE LLMS IN CHINA – TOWARD SYSTEMIC GOVERNANCE UNDER HEALTHY CHINA 2030

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to a 12,000-question Q&A benchmark using clinical vignettes, patient inquiries, and policy-based questions to measure adherence to "justice and fairness in treatment," "equity of access," and "bias and harm prevention" against expert-validated gold standard answers.
